Description: Oswald enters the room and speaks with Tony Dauer, discussing the room’s history and their identities. After a brief conflict, Oswald leaves. Then the drawer is opened and closed again, and Tony also leaves.
Location: Tony Dauer's room（Tony's room）
Key Information:
  - Person No. 3 (Oswald) enters the room and finds Tony Dauer inside; a drawer is pulled open and then shut.
  - Tony Dauer questions whether Oswald was going through his things; Oswald explains he didn’t know anyone was staying in the room.
  - Tony says his sister once talked about Oswald; Oswald says this room used to be their nursery.
  - They argue, and Tony demands Oswald leave the room.
  - Oswald leaves. The drawer is opened and closed again, and Tony Dauer also leaves afterward.
Characters:
  [Oswald（Oswald）] Person No. 3, enters Tony Dauer’s room.
    · Talks with Tony and says the room used to be their nursery.
    · Is told to leave by Tony and does so without further interference.
  [Tony Dauer（Tony Dauer）] Person No. 4, the current occupant of the room, warns Oswald not to enter again.
    · Clashes with Oswald and orders him to leave.
    · Mentions his sister once spoke about Oswald and shows dissatisfaction with Oswald’s actions.
